button_2P = {
    click_function='click2P', color={0,0,0,0},
    position={-3.4,0.65,0}, width=1250, height=2500,
    tooltip="2 Players"
}
button_3P = {
    click_function='click3P', color={0,0,0,0},
    position={-0.05,0.65,0}, width=1250, height=2500,
    tooltip="3 Players"
}
button_4P = {
    click_function='click4P', color={0,0,0,0},
    position={3.35,0.65,0}, width=1250, height=2500,
    tooltip="4 Players"
}
sCardLoc = {
    ["Red"]={-30.50, 2, -18},
    ["Yellow"]={-36, 2, 12.5},
    ["Green"]={37, 2, 12.5},
    ["Blue"]={30.5, 2, -18}
}
areaLoc = {
    {-9.31, 1, -1.84},
    {-3.17, 1, -1.84},
    {2.96, 1, -1.84},
    {9.10, 1, -1.84},
    {-6.24, 1, -6.45},
    {-0.10, 1, -6.45},
    {6.03, 1, -6.45},
    {-3.09, 1, -11.06},
    {2.96, 1, -11.06},
    {-0.10, 1, -15.67},
    --only for 3+ Players
    {-15.44, 1, -1.84},
    {-12.37, 1, -6.45},
    {-9.31, 1, -11.06},
    {-6.24, 1, -15.67},
    --only for 4 Players
    {15.23, 1, -1.84},
    {12.16, 1, -6.45},
    {9.10, 1, -11.06},
    {6.03, 1, -15.67}
    -- BS {x+1.28,y=1.1,z+1.08}
    -- pow5 {X+2.21,y=1.1,z-0.78}
}
pDestruct = {
    ["Red"] = '2a7054',
    ["Yellow"] = '8607e1',
    ["Green"] = '5e8e7a',
    ["Blue"] = 'c6d2f9'
}
function onLoad()
    math.randomseed( os.time() )
    areaDeck = getObjectFromGUID('e8c314')
    areaExtra = {
        getObjectFromGUID('d51373'),
        getObjectFromGUID('c15348'),
        getObjectFromGUID('802542')
    }
    bsDeck = getObjectFromGUID('c08752')
    power5Bag = getObjectFromGUID('b8eadf')
    orderDeck = getObjectFromGUID('d415d2')
    techDeck = getObjectFromGUID('31385b')
    achDecks = {
        getObjectFromGUID('4fedf9'),
        getObjectFromGUID('51e3b0'),
        getObjectFromGUID('382c97')
    }
    blockers = {
        getObjectFromGUID('1b6a5f'),
        getObjectFromGUID('6f47d1'),
        getObjectFromGUID('c7b74b'),
        getObjectFromGUID('fbe103')
    }
    startPCard = getObjectFromGUID('ea974a')
    yenBag = getObjectFromGUID('bdf78b')
    buttnbrd = getObjectFromGUID('4fb660')
    if buttnbrd then
        buttnbrd.createButton(button_2P)
        buttnbrd.createButton(button_3P)
        buttnbrd.createButton(button_4P)
    end
end

function click4P()
    yoPlayers = {"Red","Yellow","Green","Blue"}
    areaDeck.putObject(areaExtra[3])
    blockers[4].destruct()
    noBlock()
    setupYoka(18)
end

function click3P()
    removePlayer(3)
    limitOrders(5)
    noBlock()
    setupYoka(14)
end

function noBlock()
    blockers[3].destruct()
    blockers[2].destruct()
    blockers[1].destruct()
    areaDeck.putObject(areaExtra[2])
end

function click2P()
    removePlayer(2)
    limitOrders(16)
    setupYoka(10)
end

function removePlayer(playNum)
    yoPlayers = {}
    notPlayers = {"Red","Yellow","Green","Blue"}
    for i=4, 1, -1 do
        if Player[notPlayers[i]].seated then
            table.insert(yoPlayers,table.remove(notPlayers,i))
        end
    end
    while #yoPlayers < playNum do
        --randomly move a player to yoPlayers
        table.insert(yoPlayers,table.remove(notPlayers,math.random(#notPlayers)))
    end
    for i=playNum, 3 do
        local xPlayer = table.remove(notPlayers)
        zDestruct = getObjectFromGUID(pDestruct[xPlayer]).getObjects()
        for _, obj in ipairs(zDestruct) do
            obj.destruct()
        end
        areaExtra[i].destruct()--setPosition(sCardLoc[xPlayer])
    end
end

function limitOrders(lostOrders)
    local cutDecks = orderDeck.cut(lostOrders)
    Wait.time(function() cutDecks[2].destruct() end,1)
end

function setupYoka(dealNum)
    areaExtra[1].destruct()
    buttnbrd.destruct()
    areaDeck.shuffle()
    bsDeck.shuffle()
    power5Bag.shuffle()
    areaLoading = 0
    for i=1, dealNum do
        areaLoading = areaLoading + 1
        local dealArea = {
            position = areaLoc[i], flip = true,
            callback_function = function(obj) eachArea(obj, i) end,
        }
        areaDeck.takeObject(dealArea)
    end
    orderDeck.shuffle()
    techDeck.shuffle()
    for i=1, 6 do
        orderDeck.takeObject({position = {4.43+(i*2.33),1,12.67}, flip = true})--Port;NE
        if dealNum > 10 then
            orderDeck.takeObject({position = {(i*2.33)-20.97,1,12.67}, flip = true})--Dock;NW
        end
        techDeck.takeObject({position = {(i*2.33)-20.97,1,2.61}, flip = true})--Lab;SW
        if dealNum > 14 then
            techDeck.takeObject({position = {4.43+(i*2.33),1,2.61}, flip = true})--RC;SE
        end
    end
    for _, pColor in ipairs(yoPlayers) do
        orderDeck.deal(2,pColor)
    end
    for _, achDecki in ipairs(achDecks) do
        achDecki.shuffle()
        achDecki.takeObject({position = achDecki.getPosition(), flip = true})
        achDecki.destruct()
    end
    startPlayer = table.remove(yoPlayers,math.random(#yoPlayers))
    startPCard.setPosition(sCardLoc[startPlayer])
    if startPlayer == "Yellow" then
        startPCard.setRotation({0,270,0})
    elseif startPlayer == "Green" then
        startPCard.setRotation({0,90,0})
    end
    for _, pColor in ipairs(yoPlayers) do
        yenBag.takeObject({position = sCardLoc[pColor]})
    end
end

function eachArea(areaBoard, i)
    areaBoard.setLock(true)
    areaLoading = areaLoading - 1
    if areaBoard.getName() ~= "Canal" then
        local dealBS = {
            position = {areaLoc[i][1]+1.28,1.1,areaLoc[i][3]+1.08}, flip = true,
            callback_function = function(obj) obj.setLock(true) end,
        }
        bsDeck.takeObject(dealBS)
        local dealP5 = {
            position = {areaLoc[i][1]+2.21,1.1,areaLoc[i][3]-0.78}, rotation = {0,180,0},
        }
        power5Bag.takeObject(dealP5)
    end
    if areaLoading == 0 then
        power5Bag.destruct()
        bsDeck.destruct()
    end
end
